text:
alex (People Ops): Quick idea 10min: run a week-long "Culture Capsules" recognition window next month. Small spot awards ($30 e-gift + optional mini-swag) sent same-day nominees are approved. Can we scope this?
tara (People Ops): Love that name. Week-long works. Do we want daily caps or open nominations until budget runs out?
lena (Events): We can do a mini-swag option: enamel pin + sticker, 2-day turnaround from sticker vendor. Cost est $3/kit if ordered 200.
mike (Payroll): Quick tax note: anything under $600/year per recipient is typically non-reportable, but we need to log awards for payroll records. Also need recipient email + legal name for records.
tara (People Ops): Good call. We'll collect legal name and preferred email. Keep nominator optional.
alex (People Ops): Operational constraints: prefer bulk vendor e-gifts to avoid manual sending. Lena, can you get vendor quotes (e-gift provider + kit fulfillment) by Wed?
lena (Events): Yep. Will ping two vendors and ask about bulk API or CSV upload options.
mike (Payroll): Also, if we do prepaid cards vs vendor e-gifts, prepaid cards add reconciliation overhead. Recommend vendor e-gift codes.
tara (People Ops): For approvals: to move fast, let's do manager auto-notify for awards >$50. For $30 awards, no manager approval. Simons group asked for manager visibility though. Maybe an optional manager cc.
alex (People Ops): Keep it simple for launch: peer-to-peer only, manager cc optional. We'll document expansion later.
swag-bot: Reminder: prior spot-award program had 120 awards used in 2024 pilot. Consider similar opt-in rates.
lena (Events): Timeline idea: nominations open Mon May 5 - Sun May 11. Vendors confirmed by Apr 28, final list sent to vendor Mon May 12, awards delivered May 13-15.
tara (People Ops): Sounds good. I can draft the announcement and short nomination form. Form fields: nominee (required), reason (1 sentence), preferred email (required), ship-to (optional), nominator (optional).
mike (Payroll): For records: include internal UID in spreadsheet and mark as "recognition" for payroll import. I'll take the final sheet template and add a column for legal name + employee ID.
alex (People Ops): Action list:
- lena: vendor quotes + CSV/API capability by Wed Apr 24
- tara: nomination form + announcement draft by Fri Apr 26
- mike: payroll column spec and import checklist by Fri Apr 26
- alex: budget ask to finance and set GL code by Mon Apr 29
Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can do those.
lena (Events): :white_check_mark:
tara (People Ops): :white_check_mark:
mike (Payroll): :white_check_mark:
alex (People Ops): Thanks. One more Q: do we allow anonymous nominations? I think yes, but require contact info for award delivery.
tara (People Ops): Yes anonymous ok. We'll make nominator optional and include a "follow-up contact" field if nominator wants a thank-you note.
lena (Events): Vendor note: some vendors require proof-of-employee for mailing swag internationally. I'll flag that in vendor questions.
mike (Payroll): If we have international recipients, ensure vendor provides customs-friendly packaging and that we capture country on the sheet. Otherwise shipping may be delayed.
alex (People Ops): Great catch. Add shipping-country to form.
swag-bot: Scheduled reminder posted to #people-ops on 1781008400 to review vendor quotes.
tara (People Ops): I'll post draft announcement once the form is up for review. Keep messaging short: "Nominate a teammate who brightened your week."
alex (People Ops): Closing note: target to keep this light and surprise-y. We'll iterate based on participation numbers. Thanks team.
